list: The official 55 PS5 trophies, as published on PlayStation Network and reported 18 November 2026

sources.name: PlayStation Network trophy list, reported by Exophase and cross-checked with PSNProfiles and TrueAchievements
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap, All 55 Trophies
Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements
GTA Vibes — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements

notes: Names, descriptions and grades are the official PlayStation Network text. Guides below are written in our own words from those descriptions and the cited public guides; no guide text is copied. The game released 19 November 2026, so a few hidden trophies' exact triggers are still being confirmed by the community — those entries say so plainly instead of inventing a method. One trophy is potentially missable: Positive Mental Attitude (see its entry and the roadmap). There is no mission replay, so keep a manual save at the start of every chapter and one before the final mission.

roadmap.title: Road to the Platinum — Vice Got a Price!
roadmap.estimate: Roughly 200-300 hours in total, by the early guides (Push Square, KeenGamer). No online trophies, no difficulty trophies, no mission medals: the platinum is long, not hard.

phases.title: Play the story, enjoy it
phases.text: Just play the campaign at your own pace. The 17 story trophies (chapters, key missions and the finales for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone) unlock naturally as you go, and the finale trophy is gold. Do not use cheats: they disable trophies and saving.

phases.title: Save before every chapter
phases.text: There is no mission replay and no New Game Plus, so keep a manual save at the start of every chapter and one before the final mission. This is your only safety net, and it is essential for the one missable trophy.

phases.title: Meditate early — the missable one
phases.text: Positive Mental Attitude needs every meditation spot, and one of them — Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 — is only available during that chapter. Meditate there before Chapter 1 ends, or your only fix is an earlier save.

phases.title: Sample everything once
phases.text: Try one of each activity type (Master of None), win a race, fish with Cal, finish an arcade game, bowl at Kolt & Associates, and visit Ocean Beach for a cocktail. Sampling early shows you what the longer grinds will ask for.

phases.title: Work the world after the story
phases.text: After the finale the 100% completion checklist unlocks. Clear it systematically: 8 stranger strands, 250 stunts, 50 challenges, 3 card sets, WAiNK at 100 locations, 100 vehicles discovered, every meditation spot, and exploring all of Leonida.

phases.title: Robberies and money
phases.text: Rob 5 bank vaults, an armored truck, a jewelry store undetected and one illegal operation per gang. Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts, spend $100,000 in shops and buy every garage property.

phases.title: Clean up, then the platinum
phases.text: Finish the shooting-range golds, the Top Fun drone races at every location, the hunting strand for Bret and the last odd hidden trophies. A Long Road (100% completion, gold) is usually the last trophy before the platinum pops.

missable.why: One meditation spot — Lucia's balcony in Chapter 1 — is only available during that chapter, and the game has no mission replay. Reported by KeenGamer and Output Lag, November 2026.

warnings: Cheats disable trophies and saving (reported by PowerPyx; the same rule applied in GTA 5). Cheats only unlock after the story anyway.
Every other trophy is believed obtainable after the story in free roam, but the game is a day old: keep chapter-start saves until the community confirms the full missable list.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own — there is no separate task behind it. The road runs through the whole story, 100% completion and every side grind in this guide, and the early guides put the full platinum at roughly 200 to 300 hours. No online play is needed: all 55 trophies are single-player.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is the first story mission, so this unlocks naturally in the opening hour — just play through the intro and the trophy pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1 by playing its story missions through to the chapter's end. Unmissable as long as you keep following the main story. Before the chapter ends, remember the one missable trophy in this guide: meditate at Lucia's balcony spot while you still can.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. Keep following the story missions; the trophy pops when the chapter's final mission ends. From this chapter on, both protagonists are in play, which opens up most of the side activities in this guide.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. Another story trophy that comes from playing the campaign through — no side content is required for it, and it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. Keep playing the story missions to the chapter's end. Keep a manual save from the start of the chapter, as with every chapter — there is no mission replay if you want to revisit anything later.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of the story — this is one of only two gold trophies. It pops when the finale ends, and finishing the story also unlocks the in-game 100% completion checklist you will need for A Long Road. Keep a manual save from just before the finale.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. A story trophy: play the campaign and it unlocks when the mission ends. No special preparation or loadout is needed.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. Play through the campaign; the trophy pops at the end of this heist mission. It is unmissable in a normal story playthrough.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. A campaign trophy that unlocks when the mission ends — just keep playing the story.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Story trophy: it pops when the mission ends, with nothing extra to do.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown, set around Vice City International Airport. A campaign trophy that unlocks at the end of the mission.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. A campaign trophy: finish the mission and it pops. No side content is needed for it.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. The in-game 100% checklist unlocks after the story and covers the story itself, stranger mission strands, activities, collectibles and exploring Leonida. This is the longest trophy in the game and the second gold; for most players it is the last trophy earned before the platinum, so treat it as the clean-up list and work through it with this guide's tracker.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts — jumps, near misses, long air time and other trick driving, tracked by the game as you drive. Chain them during normal travel around Leonida and the count climbs on its own; Push Square reports 397 stunts in the game, so you need a little over half of them. A fast car, open roads and the countryside's jumps make the grind quicker.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try one of each activity type the game offers — races, fishing, the shooting range, drone races, arcade games, bowling, meditation and hunting are among them. You only need to sample each one once; you do not have to win, finish first or master any of them. Open the in-game activities menu to see which types you have not tried yet.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge. Visit the shooting ranges around Leonida and gold-medal each challenge — accuracy and speed both matter, so learn each range's targets before going for gold, and replay a challenge as often as you like; nothing here is missable.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every Top Fun location on the map. Learn each course's corners and gates, and retry a location until you win — a loss costs nothing but the attempt. Work through the locations one by one and tick them off in this tracker as you win them.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any race type counts, but winning the same race twice does not add to the total — work through different events across Leonida instead. Short street races with a well-tuned car are the fastest way to rack up distinct wins.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal at a fishing spot and take him on head-to-head — bring your best rod, watch the tension meter so the line does not snap, and reel steadily when the fish runs. You can retry the challenge if you lose it.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Play any arcade cabinet in Leonida through to its end — you do not need a high score, just a full playthrough. Pick the cabinet whose game you find easiest and finish one run.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Follow Andy's mission strand — his jobs appear as you play — through to its last mission. Side-character finales like this one are unmissable once you start the strand; just finish what you started.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Work through Kenton's strand of missions until the last one ends and the trophy pops. Like the other character finales, it is unmissable once the strand is underway.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Follow Billy's missions to their conclusion — the trophy unlocks when his final job is done.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Stranger missions appear as icons around the map — meet the stranger, play their strand through to its end, and move on to the next. Eight full strands are needed, and the character finales in this guide (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) are among the strands that can count toward it.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Play Randy's mission strand through to its last job and the trophy pops when it ends.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Follow Tyrone's strand to its final mission and finish it — the trophy unlocks at the end.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot across Leonida. MISSABLE — the one trophy in the game that can be missed: one spot, Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1, is only available during that chapter, and the game has no mission replay (reported by KeenGamer and Output Lag). Meditate there before Chapter 1 ends, and keep a manual save from the start of each chapter. The remaining spots stay available in free roam after the story, so sweep them with the map once the finale is done.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunting strand points you at one specific rare animal — follow his missions, track the target to where it roams, and take the shot when it appears. Bring a scoped rifle and approach quietly; a spooked animal is much harder to find again.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida — in shops, interiors and out in the world. Pick up every card you spot and check the collection menu to see which sets you are close to finishing; three finished sets earns the silver. Cards stay collectible after the story, so this is a good post-game sweep.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK is the in-game photo-sharing feature on the phone — open it at a new spot, snap the shot, and the location counts. Fast-travel around Leonida and WAiNK at every landmark, viewpoint and new district you visit; the count is cumulative, so it grows naturally as you explore.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges are the small goals listed in the game's challenge menu across driving, combat, exploration and more — tick off 50 across any categories. Many complete themselves during normal play; check the menu for the near-finished ones and mop those up first.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape the heat. Build a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then break line of sight and hide until the stars clear. The countryside, tunnels and water work better than the city centre — get out of the search area, stay out of sight, and wait for the heat to die down.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Rob one shop, keep the heat, and hit two more in a row before the wanted level fades. Plan a route of three close-together shops in advance, keep a fast getaway car nearby, and do not let the stars drop between robberies.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Simply drive — or ride in — 100 different vehicle models; a new model counts the first time you get in it. Variety is the point: try everything from scooters and sedans to trucks, boats and aircraft as you come across them, and the total climbs fast.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is the slow-motion targeting mode — activate it with a group of enemies in front of you and drop five before it ends. A crowded shootout with plenty of cover is the place to try it; if you fall short, the attempt costs nothing and you can try again at the next fight.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — Vice City International Airport. Steal a plane and take off from the airport without a scheduled flight, or otherwise leave by air on your own terms. Expect heavy police attention on the runway, so pick a quiet moment, grab a fast aircraft and get airborne before the response closes in.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Rhinos are the game's tanks, and this trophy involves a confrontation with them. The exact trigger is still being pinned down by the community — the game is a day old and no guide has confirmed the precise condition yet. Check the cited sources for the latest confirmed method rather than guessing; this entry will be updated when the method is verified.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet: no alarms tripped and nobody spotting you. Plan the approach, keep to cover, take the goods and leave before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, leave and try again — a failed attempt costs nothing but the trip.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Bank vault robberies are the bigger jobs — plan each one, crack the vault, and get clean away after the take. Five successful vault robberies with an escape earns the silver; a getaway car and a route out of the search area are worth setting up before you go in.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Ambush an armored truck on the road, stop it, crack it open and get away before the police close in. A quiet stretch of road and a fast car make the escape far easier than trying it in the middle of Vice City.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Visit every named area of the map — every district, town and stretch of countryside. Driving through an area counts; check the map for greyed-out corners you have not visited yet and sweep them in one long road trip after the story.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang. Gang operations are marked around Leonida — find one per gang and rob it. Keep a note of which gangs you have hit so far, and work through the list methodically; the operations stay available after the story.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to a bar on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and take in the view. A quiet one — no combat, no chase and nothing to fail. The name is a nod to the very first GTA's opening line.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car through a showroom's glass front and out the other side — a deliberate, cinematic exit in the spirit of the old games. Pick a showroom, build a little speed inside, and aim for the glass.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Go to that specific bowling alley in Vice City, play a frame and follow through on the throw. You do not need a strike — just a completed bowl at that alley.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. The exact trigger for this one is still unconfirmed — the description hints at a partner moment that draws a crowd. This entry says so plainly rather than inventing a method: check the cited guides for the confirmed trigger once the community pins it down, and treat it as a post-story clean-up item.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse. This tracks the choices you make across the game — story decisions, side-mission calls and the like — and pops once you have made enough of them. Keep playing and choosing; it will come on its own in a full playthrough, and the exact count is still being confirmed by the community.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. The community's working read is that this pops when you fail something and then succeed on the second attempt — a retry that lands. The precise trigger is still being confirmed, so do not force it: play normally, retry what you fail, and it should come. Check the cited guides for the confirmed method.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? This is the game's strange-encounter trophy — witness something out of the ordinary out in Leonida, the kind of odd event the series hides in remote corners. No confirmed method exists yet, a day after launch; the community suspects a UFO or cryptid-style sighting. Check the cited guides for the verified trigger rather than chasing rumours.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Knock someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle — a slow drive-by swing at a pedestrian. The precise conditions are still being confirmed by the community; try it on a quiet road at low speed, and check the cited guides for the verified method.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies; launder them through your contacts and the total counts toward $250,000. It adds up across the whole game, so keep robbing and laundering steadily — the bank vaults and armored trucks in this guide are the fastest source of marked bills.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Buy clothes, weapons, food and gear — all shop spending counts, cumulatively, across the whole game. Big-ticket purchases such as vehicles and high-end weapons move the total fastest, so save the expensive shopping for when you want this to pop.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Buy every garage property listed for sale around Leonida. Save up first — they are not cheap — and check property listings as you travel, since garages also give you somewhere to store the vehicles you are discovering for Whip It Good.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the Scooter Bros app on the in-game phone and register ten vehicles you own or find — any ten will do. It pairs naturally with Whip It Good: register each new vehicle you discover as you go.
